## Depth by LPC vs POC flux, controlled by month and latitude

## GAM LPC vs depth
```{r}
df.profile.lpc <- df.profile %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  select(station_year, DOY) %>% 
  distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T)
)

# GAM of LPC flux with bottom depth, latitude, and sampling day and year as predictors
mod.lpc <- gam(
  total_gC_flux_m2 ~ s(bottom_depth_m, k = 4) + DOY + Year + s(latitude, k = 4),
  data = df.profile.lpc,
  method = "REML"
)

# GAM results
summary(mod.lpc)

# Fit bottom depth vs LPC flux
newdat <- data.frame(
  bottom_depth_m = seq(min(df.profile.lpc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE),
                       max(df.profile.lpc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE),
                       length.out = 200),
  Year = mean(df.profile.lpc$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
  DOY = mean(df.profile.lpc$DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
  latitude = mean(df.profile.lpc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
)

pred <- predict(mod.lpc, newdata = newdat, se.fit = TRUE)

newdat$fit <- pred$fit
newdat$lwr <- pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit
newdat$upr <- pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit


# Fit latitude vs LPC flux
newdat2 <- data.frame(
  latitude = seq(min(df.profile.lpc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                       max(df.profile.lpc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                       length.out = 208),
  Year = mean(df.profile.lpc$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
  DOY = mean(df.profile.lpc$DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
  bottom_depth_m = mean(df.profile.lpc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)
)

pred2 <- predict(mod.lpc, newdata = newdat2, se.fit = TRUE)

newdat2$fit <- pred2$fit
newdat2$lwr <- pred2$fit - 1.96 * pred2$se.fit
newdat2$upr <- pred2$fit + 1.96 * pred2$se.fit

```


## GAM POC vs depth
```{r}
df.profile.poc <- flux.com.profiles.200 %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(station_year, DOY, Year, latitude = object_lat) %>% 
              distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T)
  )

# GAM of POC flux at 200 m with bottom depth, latitude, and sampling day and year as predictors
mod.poc <- gam(
  poc_gC_m2_yr ~ s(bottom_depth_m, k = 3) + DOY + Year + s(latitude, k = 3),
  data = df.profile.poc,
  method = "REML"
)

summary(mod.poc)

# Fit POC flux at 200m vs bottom depth
newdat.poc <- data.frame(
  bottom_depth_m = seq(min(df.profile.poc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE),
                       max(df.profile.poc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE),
                       length.out = 151),
  Year = mean(df.profile.poc$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
  DOY = mean(df.profile.poc$DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
  latitude = mean(df.profile.poc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
)

pred <- predict(mod.poc, newdata = newdat.poc, se.fit = TRUE)

newdat.poc$fit <- pred$fit
newdat.poc$lwr <- pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit
newdat.poc$upr <- pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit


# Fit POC flux at 200m vs latitude
newdat.poc2 <- data.frame(
  latitude = seq(min(df.profile.poc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                 max(df.profile.poc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                 length.out = 208),
  Year = mean(df.profile.poc$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
  DOY = mean(df.profile.poc$DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
  bottom_depth_m = mean(df.profile.poc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)
)

pred2 <- predict(mod.poc, newdata = newdat.poc2, se.fit = TRUE)

newdat.poc2$fit <- pred2$fit
newdat.poc2$lwr <- pred2$fit - 1.96 * pred2$se.fit
newdat.poc2$upr <- pred2$fit + 1.96 * pred2$se.fit
```

The LPC flux model explained 44.8% of deviance with Radj2 = 0.43 (n = 208) with a weak negative effect of day of year (β = −0.012, p = 0.023) and no significant effect of year. The GAM smooths (±95% CI) terms were significant between LPC flux and (a) latitude (edf = 2.82, F = 9.1, p < 0.001) and (b) bottom depth (edf = 2.85, F = 33.11, p < 0.001). 

The POC flux model explained 27.6% of deviance with Radj2 = 0.25 (n = 151) with a positive year (β = 1.25, p = 0.001) and no significant effect of day of year. The GAM smooths (±95% CI) terms were significant between POC flux and (c) latitude (edf = 1.61, F = 6.65, p = 0.006) and (d) bottom depth (edf = 1.84, F = 5.88, p = 0.007).

# Size gradient with depth
## Calculate CWM traits
```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
# Calculate community weighted mean of mean traits (weighted by abundance)
cwm.profiles <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # only include Calanus spp
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # add volume filtered
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max / 5) * 5 + 2.5) %>% 
  left_join(volumes.df) %>% 
  # add regions
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuk, reg.inuk, station_year)) %>% 
  # filter samples for analysis
  filter(!is.na(region.inuk)) %>% 
  # calculate portion of the volume to get relative abundance
  mutate(rel_abundance = Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  mutate(temperature_C = temperature_kelvin - 273.15) %>% 
  select(station_year, region.inuk, reg.inuk, rel_abundance,
         prosome_length_mm, lipid_fullness, waxester_mass_mgC, temperature_C,
         respirationRate_ugCday, diapauseDuration_day, 
         structural_carbon_mgC, prosome_total_mgC) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, region.inuk, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ weighted.mean(.x, rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)),
            nindivs = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  select(-rel_abundance) %>% 
  # Add bottom depth information
  left_join(df.profile %>% 
              select(station_year, bottom_depth_m))

cwm.profiles.long <- cwm.profiles %>% 
  select(-c(prosome_total_mgC, structural_carbon_mgC)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(prosome_length_mm, lipid_fullness, waxester_mass_mgC,
                        respirationRate_ugCday, diapauseDuration_day,
                        temperature_C),
               names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(trait = factor(trait, 
                        levels = c("prosome_length_mm", "waxester_mass_mgC",
                                   "respirationRate_ugCday", "lipid_fullness", 
                                   "diapauseDuration_day", "temperature_C")))
  

flabels <- c("prosome_length_mm" = "a. Prosome length\n(mm)", 
             "waxester_mass_mgC" = "b. Wax ester carbon\n(mg C)",
             "respirationRate_ugCday" = "c. Diapause respiration rate\n(\u03bcg C day⁻¹)",
             "lipid_fullness" = "d. Lipid fullness\n(%)", 
             "diapauseDuration_day" = "e. Potential diapause duration\n(day)", 
             "temperature_C" = "f. Ambient temperature\n(°C)")

ggplot(cwm.profiles.long, aes(x = reg.inuk, y = value,
                         color = reg.inuk)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev, labels = flabels) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank()) +
  facet_wrap(~trait, scales = "free_x",
              labeller = as_labeller(flabels))
  
# ggsave("figures/CWM_Traits.png", width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")

# Ambient temp vs respiration rate and diapause duration
plot_grid(
ggplot(cwm.profiles, aes(x = temperature_C, y = respirationRate_ugCday)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = region.inuk)) +

  scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +

ggplot(cwm.profiles, aes(x = prosome_total_mgC, y = respirationRate_ugCday)) +

ggplot(cwm.profiles, aes(x = temperature_C, y = diapauseDuration_day)) +

ggplot(cwm.profiles, aes(x = waxester_mass_mgC, y = diapauseDuration_day)) +
```

# Check taxonomic composition by bottom depth. Where are C. glacialis vs C. hyperboreus
```{r}
# Net data
load("data/hydrobios_net_calanus_20260321.RData")

net.bot.depths <- uvp_net_match %>% 
  mutate(YEAR_STATION = paste(cruise_year, STATION_NAME)) %>% 
  distinct(YEAR_STATION, BOTTOM_DEPTH) %>% 
  arrange(BOTTOM_DEPTH)


calanus.by.depth <- calanus %>% 
  left_join(net.bot.depths,
            by = join_by(YEAR_STATION)) %>% 
  mutate(YEAR_STATION = factor(YEAR_STATION, 
                               levels = net.bot.depths$YEAR_STATION)) %>% 
  mutate(tax_stage = paste(TAXON_ID, TAXON_LIFE_DEV_STAGE)) %>% 
   group_by(YEAR_STATION, STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,
           TAXON_ID, tax_stage, BOTTOM_DEPTH) %>% 
  summarise(total_abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            mean_abundance_m3 = weighted.mean(abundance_m3, w = Depth_range),
            total_indiv_count = sum(indiv_count),
            maxDepth = max(MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH),
            nbins = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(calanus.by.depth, aes(x = YEAR_STATION, y = total_abundance_m2,
                                fill = tax_stage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1), 
                     labels = c(0,25,50,75,100),
                     expand = c(0,0)) +
  # scale_x_discrete(labels = BOTTOM_DEPTH) +
  ylab("% Abundance") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

# TODO Get biomass instead


# Species composition of nets by region
# Calculate net integrated abundance and biomass
species.comp.station <- calanus.by.depth %>%
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,
           TAXON_ID, BOTTOM_DEPTH) %>% 
  summarise(total_abundance_m2 = sum(total_abundance_m2),
            nbins = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(TAXON_ID = case_match(TAXON_ID,
                               "Calanus finmarchicus" ~ "Cfin CV-F",
                               "Calanus glacialis" ~ "Cgla CIV-F",
                               "Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "Chyp CIV-F")) %>% 
  # relative abundance
  group_by(YEAR_STATION) %>% 
  mutate(assem_abundance_m2 = sum(total_abundance_m2)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(relative_abundance = total_abundance_m2/assem_abundance_m2*100) %>% 
  left_join(uvp_net_match %>% 
              distinct(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,
                       LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, reg.inuk),
            by = join_by(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START))


ggplot(species.comp.station, aes(x = YEAR_STATION, y = total_abundance_m2,
                                fill = TAXON_ID)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1), 
                     labels = c(0,25,50,75,100),
                     expand = c(0,0)) +
  ylab("% Abundance") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

```

# Map out how composition is divided
```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=7}
library(ggOceanMaps)
library(ggspatial)

clrs <- c("firebrick2","sienna1","goldenrod2","forestgreen",
          "blue1","purple2","deeppink1")

basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = F, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-85,-52,65,83), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "ivory",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  
  # mark net samples
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = comp_uvp_net,
                                aes(x = longitude, y = latitude,
                                    color = reg.inuk),
                                size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
  
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_label_repel(data = comp_uvp_net,
                                aes(x = longitude, y = latitude,
                                    label = STATION_NAME),
                                size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs, name = "Region") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "none",
        legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12))
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
        limits = c(-85,-52,65,83), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "gray",
        land.border.col = NA, gla.border.col = NA) +
  
  # mark net samples
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = species.comp.station,
                                aes(x = LONGITUDE, y = LATITUDE,
                                    fill = relative_abundance, 
                                    size = total_abundance_m2),
                                color = "black", shape = 21,
                                alpha = 0.8) +
  # scale_size_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12)) +
  facet_wrap(~TAXON_ID, nrow = 1)
```

## comparisons
```{r}
AA <- species.comp.station %>% 
  select(YEAR_STATION, reg.inuk, BOTTOM_DEPTH, TAXON_ID, relative_abundance) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = TAXON_ID, values_from = relative_abundance)

ggplot(AA, aes(x = `Cgla CIV-F`, y = `Chyp CIV-F`)) +
  geom_abline() +
  geom_point(aes(color = BOTTOM_DEPTH, shape = reg.inuk),
             size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = reg.inuk, linetype = reg.inuk),
               linewidth = 0.5, level = 0.8, alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma")

ggplot(species.comp.station, aes(x = BOTTOM_DEPTH, y = relative_abundance)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth() +
  facet_wrap(~TAXON_ID, nrow = 1)

ggplot(species.comp.station, aes(x = LATITUDE, y = relative_abundance)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth() +
  facet_wrap(~TAXON_ID, nrow = 1)
```
